test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 27 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Refer to the following letter, number, symbol series and answer the question.

(Left) B & Z $ 6 N M @ 4 X & 7 L # 3 T Z * 5 (Right)

How many such symbols are there which are immediately preceded by a letter and also immediately followed by a number?
solution:
Such symbols are there which are immediately preceded by a letter and also immediately followed by a number are shown below:

**Letters → Symbols → Number**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fd7e3b4537c63f697abea29ed57c0ff9ec9ce70b327a80d33e7a1a7ee4d4ec14.png] 

Thus, there are **5 such patterns**:

 
• Z $ 6
 
• M @ 4
 
• X & 7
 
• L # 3
 
• Z * 5

 

Hence, the correct answer is **'Option (1).**
